newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chicago Miniature cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chicago Miniature cut.

text.p: -- Raymond James Financial said it lowered its recommendation on Chicago Miniature Lamp Inc to neutral from buy.
-- Shares were off 10-3/4 to 32 in midday Nasdaq trade.
-- Analyst John Mahoney said in a research note the downgrade was based on the company's fourth quarter earnings reported Monday morning of $0.28 per share.

-- "The fourth quarter earnings were aided by approximately $0.05 per share of currency gains, thus the actual operating results were some $0.04 below our estimate of $0.27 per share," according to the note.
-- "Given the stock's current multiple of 38 times earnings, we believe it is imperative for the company to execute and meet expectations," the research note stated.
